CREATE VIEW [BIQL].[DimCurrencyExchangeRatesUSDDaily]
AS
WITH 

--Revised PS, T. Sampson 12/9/21 to eliminate duplicate calendar date and 2 exchange rates on the first of each month
/* Get Rates from Exchange Rates File for USD only */
CTE AS
(
select 
 CE.CurrencyCodeFrom AS "CurrencyCodeFrom"
,CF.CurrencyCodeSKey AS "CurrencyCodeFromSKey"
,CT.CurrencyCodeSKey AS "CurrencyCodeToSKey"
,CE.EffectiveDate AS "Effective Date"
,CE.CurrencyConversionSpotRate AS "Exchange Rate"
,LEAD(CE.EffectiveDate) over (PARTITION BY CurrencyCodeFrom, CurrencyCodeTo ORDER BY CE.EffectiveDate) as NextDate  --Identifies the next date where there is an exchange rate
FROM BIQL.DimCurrencyExchangeRates CE
INNER JOIN BIQL.DimCurrencyCode CF ON CE.CurrencyCodeFrom=CF.CurrencyCode
INNER JOIN BIQL.DimCurrencyCode CT ON CE.CurrencyCodeTo=CT.CurrencyCode
where CurrencyCodeTo in (SELECT DISTINCT CurrencyCode from BIQL.DimCompany)
and CurrencyCodeTo = 'USD'  --12/10/21 - note this is filtering out all non-USD conversions
and CE.EffectiveDateID != 0
and CE.CurrencyRateType=''
)

/* Explode Exchange Rates file to make sure one record per calendar date, uses the previous days rate if no rate exists */ 

select DC.CalendarDate, CTE.CurrencyCodeFrom, CTE.CurrencyCodeFromSKey, CTE.CurrencyCodeToSKey, CTE.[Effective Date], CTE.[Exchange Rate]
FROM BIQL.DimCalendar DC
JOIN CTE ON DC.CalendarPatternSKey = 1 AND DC.CalendarDate BETWEEN CTE.[Effective Date] AND ISNULL(DATEADD(day, -1, CTE.NextDate),CTE."Effective Date")
